title: 25_ACE service registry
description: The one owner of ports and base URLs for the editor, the Orchestrator, the A2A agents and shared infrastructure. Everything else (infra/dev/runtime.mjs, the host supervisor, the status page) derives from it; the Orchestrator's a2a.ps1 and config/*_agent.json are compared against it by infra/host/derivation.test.mjs, never edited from here.

owner_repo.description: Repository that owns the process, as a path relative to D:/Data/25_ACE.

management.description: agent-host: started by the Orchestrator launcher; editor-session: started by infra/dev/product.mjs (and, when lifecycle is persistent, kept alive by infra/host); external: docker or a manual process.

host_env.description: Environment variable the editor host reads to override the base URL. Unset -> http://127.0.0.1:{port}.

compose.description: How the host activates an external entry that a docker compose project serves: `docker compose up -d <service>` in <project> (relative to D:/Data/25_ACE). The host never spawns `start` for such an entry.

idle_timeout_s.description: On-demand entries only: the host stops the process this long after its last lease ended (never before min_up). Absent/null = never stopped for idleness.

memory_mb.description: Measured resident size when idle (2026-10-09: agents 80-90 MB); informs the memory guard.

card_url.description: A2A agent card (agents/a2a_common/protocol.py serves it at /.well-known/agent-card.json).

start.description: How the owner starts it. cwd is relative to D:/Data/25_ACE; '{port}' in cmd is filled from port. For agents this mirrors a2a.ps1 and is informational for the host.

launcher.description: The entry OrchestratorAgent/scripts/services/a2a.ps1 keeps for this agent (its join keys). Present exactly when kind is agent.
